clue.text: The world of dress ?

definitions.meaning: the whole universe as made, everything brought into being
a couturier's showpiece gown is called by this word

explanation.surface: A fashion question: what is the world of dress all about?
explanation.definitionFit: The universe is what was made at the beginning; a fashion designer's new gown is likewise a made piece.

clue.text: King does a double side-step

parts.note: in chess the king moves two squares sideways when exchanging places with a rook

explanation.surface: A monarch performs a dance step twice to the side.
explanation.walkthrough: The king sounds like a dancing monarch, but this is the chess king, which moves two squares sideways in this move.
explanation.definitionFit: The chess move in which the king moves two squares toward a rook, which jumps over it.

clue.text: Leaves producer-always gets part of course

parts.note: ever means always
the green is part of a golf course

explanation.surface: A producer quits, always taking part of a course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leaves' looks like a verb (departs), but it is the noun: foliage. The course is a golf course.
explanation.definitionFit: A tree or shrub keeping its foliage all year round is a constant producer of greenery.

clue.text: New setter is about 6-managing sort of chap!

indicators.note: about means the rearranged letters go round the letter from 6
new means the letters of setter are made over in a fresh order

parts.note: 6-down's answer split as 'up' and 'start' means the start of up, its first letter

explanation.surface: A new crossword setter is about to manage things.
explanation.walkthrough: The reference to 6-down is a pun: read that answer as 'up start' and it gives the start of 'up', the letter U.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone holding and administering property for another is a managing figure.

clue.text: A speech for a zero allocation

parts.note: O looks like zero
a ration is an allocation

explanation.surface: Someone gives a speech about getting nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal address delivered on a ceremonial occasion.

clue.text: Schoolboy's exclamation, being found on board ?

definitions.meaning: a mild old-fashioned cry of surprise, like 'gosh'
fragments of bread left on the table, the board

explanation.surface: A schoolboy cries out on discovering something aboard ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Board' looks like a ship's deck, but it is the old sense of a dining table, where bread fragments fall.
explanation.definitionFit: A dated British cry of surprise, and the bits of bread scattered over a table after a meal.

clue.text: Footsore composer in rural area

parts.note: a corn is a sore on the foot
John Field was an Irish composer of nocturnes

explanation.surface: A composer with aching feet out in the countryside.
explanation.walkthrough: John Field (1782-1837) was the Irish composer who invented the nocturne.
explanation.definitionFit: A field of wheat or other grain is farmland in the countryside.

clue.text: The bottom rung for this parvenu ?

definitions.text: The bottom rung for this parvenu

parts.words: The bottom rung for this parvenu
parts.note: a social climber starts from low down, the bottom rung of a ladder being where one starts going up

explanation.surface: A social climber begins from the lowest step.
explanation.definitionFit: A newcomer who has risen suddenly in rank, beginning from the bottom on the way up.

clue.text: Tradesman is only dear abroad

parts.note: but means only, as in 'but a child'
cher is French for dear

explanation.surface: A trader is expensive overseas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dear' reads as expensive, but it is the endearment, French 'cher'.
explanation.definitionFit: A meat seller is a tradesman in a shop.

clue.text: He might gamble on arranging tour places

indicators.note: arranging the words tour and places puts their letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A gambler bets on how a travel company will lay out its destinations.
explanation.definitionFit: One who makes risky investments hoping for profit is a gambler on markets.

clue.text: Perhaps it even includes the ground

indicators.note: the words Perhaps it even hold the answer's letters inside them, run across the word breaks

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether a plot is level, ground and all.
explanation.definitionFit: A plot of land or location where something stands or is built.

clue.text: Fear no more the (Cymbeline)

parts.note: a quotation to complete: the funeral song in Shakespeare's Cymbeline runs 'Fear no more the heat o' the sun' and later warns of a bolt from a storm

explanation.walkthrough: The dirge 'Fear no more the heat o' the sun' in Cymbeline has the later line beginning 'Fear no more the', followed by a stormy flash, then 'Nor the all-dreaded thunder-stone'.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase completes the line in the song from Shakespeare's play, naming a bolt of electricity from a storm.

clue.text: Has the woman called in the pot-house ?

parts.note: she is the pronoun for a woman
with 'Has' before it, 'has called' means 'has been' (paid a visit)

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a woman has dropped in at the local pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Has' does no work alone: asking whether someone has called is asking whether they have been round. A shebeen is an unlicensed drinking den, chiefly Irish and Scottish.
explanation.definitionFit: An illicit drinking house, the old term pot-house meaning a low tavern.

clue.text: Inscriptions contain odd phrase about a greedy type

indicators.note: about means the jumbled letters go round the greedy type
odd means the letters of phrase are put into an unusual order

parts.note: a pig is a greedy person

explanation.surface: Inscriptions carry a strange phrase about a glutton.
explanation.definitionFit: Short quotations or lines carved on a building or set at the head of a book.

clue.text: They advise people — the wrong sort

parts.note: men means people in general

indicators.note: the word sort put wrong, its letters set in a mistaken order

explanation.surface: Advisers are people of the wrong type.
explanation.definitionFit: Trusted counsellors guide the less experienced with advice.

clue.text: Master the bowling? Might

parts.note: an over is a set of six balls bowled in cricket
power means might

explanation.surface: Can you get the better of the bowlers in cricket?
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an over is a spell of six balls bowled from one end.
explanation.definitionFit: To defeat or subdue someone is to be their master.

clue.text: Book by Epstein ?

definitions.meaning: the first book of the Bible
the title of a marble sculpture of a pregnant woman by Jacob Epstein, 1931

explanation.surface: A question about a book written by someone called Epstein.
explanation.walkthrough: 'By Epstein' suggests an author, but Jacob Epstein was a sculptor and this is the title of one of his works.
explanation.definitionFit: The opening book of the Old Testament, and a famous carving by the sculptor Jacob Epstein.

clue.text: Passage from a book, but appears about right

indicators.note: about means the word for but goes round the letter for right

parts.note: except means but, as in 'all but one'

explanation.surface: A book extract appears to be correct.
explanation.definitionFit: An extract or quotation taken from a longer text.

clue.text: Wild ragweed in Greater London

definitions.note: the definition describes a place located in the capital

indicators.note: wild means the letters of ragweed are run riot into another order

explanation.surface: A weed grows wild in the London area.
explanation.walkthrough: Edgware is a suburb of north London, at the end of a Northern line Tube branch.
explanation.definitionFit: A suburb in the north of the capital's metropolitan area.

clue.text: Direct speech

definitions.meaning: to direct a letter is to write its destination on it
a formal talk given to an audience

explanation.surface: A grammar term: words reported exactly as said.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Direct speech' reads as the grammar term, but it is two separate definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: To write the destination on a parcel, and a formal talk delivered to listeners.

clue.text: Bond character in Shakespeare ?

parts.note: not a 007 figure: the merchant in The Merchant of Venice who signs a bond to Shylock for a pound of flesh

explanation.surface: A question about a James Bond figure appearing in Shakespeare.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bond character' suggests James Bond, but the bond is the loan agreement signed with Shylock in The Merchant of Venice.
explanation.definitionFit: The title merchant of Venice, who pledges a pound of flesh as surety for a loan.

clue.text: Relies upon theologians including eastern writer

indicators.note: including means the theologians hold the next pieces inside

parts.note: DDs are Doctors of Divinity
a pen is a writer

explanation.surface: Divinity scholars take in a writer from the East, relying on him.
explanation.definitionFit: To rely on is to hang on something, needing it.

clue.text: Wandered about seeking a dry seat, perhaps

indicators.note: about means the letters of dry seat are turned around into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone wanders about looking for somewhere dry to sit.
explanation.walkthrough: Only 'dry seat' is the anagram fodder; 'a' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Roamed off course, went astray.

clue.text: Rate receipt a GP amended in the case of Virginia, perhaps

indicators.note: the letters of Rate receipt a GP are amended, changed into another order

explanation.surface: A doctor's corrected bill for a patient called Virginia.
explanation.walkthrough: Virginia looks like a woman's name, but it is Virginia tobacco, which is rolled up inside the case.
explanation.definitionFit: Thin paper wrapped round tobacco such as Virginia leaf forms its casing in a hand-rolled smoke.

clue.text: Boat for a Malayan

parts.note: pro is Latin for for, as in pros and cons

explanation.surface: A vessel built for a man from Malaya.
explanation.walkthrough: The proa is a fast sailing canoe of the Malay islands, so 'Malayan' tells you where the vessel comes from.
explanation.definitionFit: A Malay outrigger sailing craft is a type of vessel.

clue.text: Enclosure Nine — the method for the North-South route

parts.note: a pen is an enclosure for animals
taken as written
a way is a method of doing something

explanation.surface: Nine pens are the method for travelling the length of the country.
explanation.walkthrough: The Pennine Way is a long-distance footpath running north to south along the Pennine hills of northern England.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-distance walking trail running down the backbone of northern England.

clue.text: Many desert their mums for these

indicators.note: desert means leave, so the letter for many is taken out

parts.note: mothers are mums
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, so many

explanation.surface: Many people abandon their mothers in favour of other people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mums' looks like part of the story of abandonment, but MOTHERS is the word M deserts.
explanation.definitionFit: The definition is the pronoun standing for the other people chosen instead of mums.

clue.text: Roundest variety of monk

definitions.note: an adjective, describing a monk's head

indicators.note: a variety of the word Roundest is a different arrangement of its letters

explanation.surface: The roundest type of monk.
explanation.walkthrough: A monk's head shaved on the crown has the bald circle, which explains 'Roundest'.
explanation.definitionFit: Having the crown shaved, as a monk traditionally does on entering holy orders.
